column1: NOTE 1:An uplink DC configuration in which the band has NOTE 3 in Table 6.2.1-1 in TS 38.101-1 or NOTE 2 in Table 6.2.2-1 in TS 36.101 is allowed to reduce the lower tolerance limit by 1.5 dB when the transmission bandwidths of at least one of the bands are confined within FUL_low and FUL_low + 4 MHz or FUL_high - 4 MHz and FUL_high.NOTE 2:Void.NOTE 3:Power Class 3 is the default power class unless otherwise stated.NOTE 4:Only single switched UL is supported.
